build_AllScAIP_backbone: build an AllScAIP backbone model with graph attention blocks and configurable molecular graph settings
create_AllScAIP_energy_head: create an AllScAIP energy head that predicts per-atom energy using a feedforward network and scatter reduction
create_AllScAIP_direct_force_head: create an AllScAIP direct force head that predicts atomic forces via a feedforward network on node representations
create_AllScAIP_gradient_energy_force_st: create an AllScAIP gradient-based head that computes energy, forces, and stress via autograd on energy output
validate_atoms_data: validate ASE atoms data charge and spin values against acceptable ranges with task-specific defaults
